products.name: Child-Resistant Flat Pouches

materials.finishing: 4mil Barrier Film Biax Nylon Poly Lam

products.description: Child-resistant flat pouches built to ASTM D3475 standards for cannabis edibles, pharmaceuticals, and other regulated products. Flat construction is cost-effective for single-serve and multi-serve formats — child-resistant zipper closure adds the compliance layer required in cannabis-regulated markets. Full-color barrier-film printing keeps brand graphics sharp. We handle the lab certification documentation on request. 5-day production.

products.name: Child-Resistant Stand Up Pouches

materials.finishing: 4mil Barrier Film Biax Nylon Poly Lam

products.description: Child-resistant stand-up pouches engineered for cannabis, pharmaceutical, and adult-product packaging — fully compliant with ASTM D3475 child-resistant standards. The press-to-close zipper requires adult dexterity to open, keeping products safely out of children's reach. Same premium barrier film and photo-quality printing as our standard stand-up pouches, with added safety certification. Required packaging in most cannabis-legal states. 5-day production.

products.name: Lay Flat Pouches

materials.finishing: 4mil Barrier Film Biax Nylon Poly Lam

products.description: Custom lay-flat pouches — the most cost-effective flexible packaging format. Perfect for single-serve snacks, samples, sachets, condiments, supplements, hardware, and any product that ships flat in cases or displays. Heat-sealed three-side construction with optional tear notches for easy opening. Printed in full-color photo-quality graphics with rich CMYK + spot colors. Available in multiple barrier film grades for shelf life from 3 months to 2+ years. 5-day production.

products.name: Stand Up Pouches

materials.finishing: 4mil Barrier Film Biax Nylon Poly Lam

products.description: Custom stand-up pouches with a flat bottom gusset so they sit upright on the shelf. The go-to packaging for coffee, snacks, supplements, pet food, cannabis, and CPG products. Printed with photo-quality graphics on multi-layer barrier film that protects against moisture, oxygen, and UV light. Choose matte, gloss, or soft-touch finish. Add resealable zipper, tear notch, hang hole, and pour spout features. We print, laminate, and ship in 5 business days — no minimums above 500 units.

products.name: Stick Pack

materials.finishing: 4mil Barrier Film Biax Nylon Poly Lam

products.description: Custom stick packs — the slim, tall flexible packaging format ideal for single-serve drink mixes, electrolyte powders, supplements, instant coffee, sugar packets, sample sachets, and on-the-go portions. Tear cleanly along a perforated line and pour. Printed on barrier film with full-color graphics that keep brand colors vibrant on a narrow profile. Built for high-speed automated filling lines but available for short runs too. 5-day production.

products.name: Backlit Film
products.description: Custom backlit film prints for lightboxes, kiosks, exhibition panels, and movie theater displays. Our 9mil backlit film delivers dense color saturation when lit from behind — text stays sharp, photos pop, and colors stay vibrant under any light source. Printed on UV-cured wide-format presses up to 60" wide. Designed for fixed installations in transit stations, retail lightboxes, restaurant menu boards, and exhibition halls. Production turnaround in 5 business days. White-ink underprint available for double-density opacity on critical brand graphics.

products.name: Clear Adhesive Vinyl
products.description: Crystal-clear adhesive vinyl for logos, lettering, and graphics where you want the glass to remain visible. Perfect for storefronts, doors, conference rooms, and high-end retail where transparency matters. Our 8mil clear vinyl with permanent adhesive delivers full-color UV-cured graphics that look like they're floating on the glass. Roland TrueVIS white-ink technology adds opaque color when you need bold visibility — colors stay solid and vibrant even on clear background. 5-day production. Optional matte or gloss lamination for extra outdoor durability.

products.name: Frosted Window Decals
products.description: Frosted etched-glass vinyl decals — get the premium look of sandblasted glass without the cost. Used for conference room privacy, bathroom doors, storefront privacy bands, hospital partitions, and decorative office branding. Our 4mil frosted film mimics real etched glass with a soft translucent finish that diffuses light while blocking direct view. Available as solid frosted bands, custom logos, or full graphic designs. Permanent adhesive holds for 5+ years and removes cleanly. Cut to any shape on our wide-format cutters. Production in 5 business days.

products.name: Laminated Posters
products.description: Laminated posters with a protective clear film bonded over the print — built to survive heavy handling, moisture, fingerprints, and UV light. Choose 3mil or 5mil lamination in your preferred gloss, matte, satin, or UV finish. Ideal for restaurant menus, point-of-purchase displays, classroom posters, trade show signage, and any high-touch graphic that needs to look new for years instead of weeks. Lamination available up to 38" wide. We print, laminate, and trim in-house at our Los Angeles facility — turnaround in 5 business days.

products.name: Perforated Window Vinyl
products.description: One-way see-through window vinyl — your message displays bold from outside while customers inside still see through. Printed on 6mil perforated vinyl with 70/30 perforation ratio, this is the same material used on storefront windows and the rear windows of vehicles. Full-color UV-cured graphics that resist fade, with permanent adhesive that holds for 3-5 years. Optional gloss or matte lamination extends outdoor life. Ideal for retail, restaurants, automotive shops, and any business that wants graphic impact without sacrificing natural light or visibility. Custom-cut to any size up to 60" wide.

products.name: Premium Posters
products.description: Premium custom posters printed on 8mil photo paper or 9oz polyester banner-poster stock — designed for retail displays, art prints, event signage, and indoor promotions. We print sharp, vibrant full-color graphics with UV-cured pigments that won't fade under store lighting. Whether you need a single statement piece or a full retail rollout, our wide-format printers deliver gallery-quality output up to 60 inches wide. Choose matte for a no-glare finish or gloss for maximum color pop. Production in 5 business days. Add lamination for extra durability on high-traffic posters.

products.name: Textured Wall Vinyl

materials.materialName: 4mil High Tack Textured Wall Vinyl, Conformable

products.description: Wall-mountable custom vinyl for interior murals, branded environments, retail walls, restaurants, gyms, and creative office spaces. We stock two grades: 8mil low-tack repositionable vinyl for smooth painted drywall (peels off cleanly, no residue), and 4mil high-tack conformable vinyl for textured surfaces like brick, cinderblock, and stucco. Full-color UV-cured graphics with rich color saturation. Cut to any shape on our wide-format cutters — full walls, single feature graphics, or repeat patterns. 5 business days from approved file to finished install-ready vinyl.

products.name: Vinyl Banners
products.description: Custom vinyl banners printed in Los Angeles — built tough for outdoor and indoor use. Choose 13oz scrim vinyl for everyday promotions or 16oz premium vinyl when you need maximum durability. We print full-color, UV-cured graphics that resist fading, water, and weather. All banners come standard with grommet holes for easy hanging and reinforced edges that hold up under wind. From grand openings and trade shows to construction sites and storefront promotions, our custom vinyl banners deliver the bold visibility your brand deserves. File-to-shelf in 5 business days. Need it faster? Same-day rush available on most orders.

products.name: Window Clings
products.description: Reusable window clings — no adhesive, no residue, just static electricity holding them in place. Perfect for short-term promotions, seasonal campaigns, holiday displays, sale signage, and event branding you'll want to remove and reuse later. Available in white (opaque, mounted from inside or outside) or clear (see-through with optional white-ink underprint for opaque color). Easily removable and re-positionable hundreds of times. We print full-color UV-cured graphics that stay vibrant outdoors. 5-day turnaround on custom orders.

products.name: Window Decals
products.description: Custom window decals for storefronts, offices, restaurants, and retail. Printed on 8mil opaque vinyl with permanent adhesive — durable indoors and out, with full-color UV-resistant graphics that stay sharp for 5+ years. Choose outside mount (standard) or inside mount with mirrored print to protect your graphic behind the glass. Perfect for business hours, logos, promotional messaging, contact info, and brand storytelling on every glass surface. Removable cleanly when you're done. Printed and cut in Los Angeles in 5 business days.

products.name: Custom Vinyl Lettering
products.description: Custom cut vinyl lettering — the gold standard for storefront signage, business hours, address numbers, vehicle text, window logos, and wall graphics. Cut from premium Oracal 651 calendered vinyl with a 6-year outdoor warranty — solid colors that never fade, never pixelate, and look exactly like professionally painted signage. Each letter is precision-cut, pre-masked with application transfer tape, and ready to install. No printing means no ink fade ever. Available in black, white, and additional colors on request. Production in 5 business days. Perfect for businesses that want a clean, permanent, professional look.
